auth.browser_origins: Exact comma-separated MESSENGER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; no permissive CORS. Non-browser clients may omit Origin. Cross-site browser requests are rejected.
auth.secret_transport: Setup passphrase and optional dedicated nsec travel only in authenticated JSON body, then private stdin/Unix socket. Require TLS termination or an authenticated local gateway. Never log/store either.

setup_semantics: No identity is created automatically. A dedicated vault passphrase of at least 16 characters is needed to create/unlock. Keyring remains encrypted at rest. Restart always relocks. account_configured reports whether an identity exists; ready may have identity=null when a new vault has only been unlocked. The one messaging key is separate from Wizard root signing.

body.display_name: optional public display name, 1..160 UTF-8 bytes
body.nsec: dedicated messaging nsec, only for import (not integration-proved; do not expose in MVP UI)

routes.result: status fields plus identity (public object or null)
routes.notes: A repeated create reuses the existing identity and repairs its stable KeyPackage publication; it never creates a new key.
Locked returns HTTP 423; a newly unlocked vault without account returns identity:null.

contacts.pubkey: original supplied lowercase npub or hex
contacts.label: local label

body.pubkey: peer npub or hex with a Marmot key package
body.name: optional local conversation name, defaults Direct message

result.reused: true when an existing direct conversation is returned

routes.notes: Reuses a known direct conversation for the exact peer instead of casually creating another MLS group. Otherwise creates a two-member group and encrypted welcome; recipient must accept.

body.request_id: optional but REQUIRED for UI retry safety: unique 16..128 alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen characters

result.replayed: true when a persisted accepted receipt is returned without another send

routes.notes: Persist request_id with the draft before first submission. Reusing it with different content is HTTP 409 request_id_conflict. Intent without a receipt returns HTTP 409 send_outcome_unknown and does not send again; refresh canonical history. No invented peer read/delivery receipt.

body.message_id: optional known event id, never message text

routes.notes: Upstream group_convergence retry republishes retained pending events, never fresh-encrypts/re-sends the plaintext body. The optional message_id is echoed for context; retry is group-scoped.
Read-only status/public identity only; no contacts, private keys, message bodies, send or arbitrary signer capability.

TextMessage.author: public hex
TextMessage.created_at: MLS-authenticated inner event timestamp as exposed by upstream
